newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: ING Barings upgrades Carulla to buy.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings upgrades Carulla to buy.

text.p: ING Barings said it was ugrading Colombian supermarket chain Carulla from hold to buy on the basis of upside stock price potential and revised earnings per share estimates.
Santander Investment said it was downgrading Carulla from market perform to underperform because of disappointing 1996 earnings and Colombia's increasingly competitive food retailing environment.
Alejandro Torres, Barings' chief of Colombia equity research, said he had revised Carulla's EPS estimates from $0.34 to $0.37 for this year, and from $0.26 to $0.34 in 1998.
"Based on a current price per share of 3,519 (pesos), Carulla should see a price appreciation of 32 percent by year-end 1997 and a 5.9 percent divident yield," Torres said
Barings said its earnings estimates had been revised in the aftermath of Carulla's decision not to issue its customary 20 percent stock dividend this year.
